name: camera-dof-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `cameraDof` flag (pro tier — PC2-CAM-DOF-LENS, `ui/HqRenderModal.tsx` + `scene/Effects.tsx`/`scene/EffectsImpl.tsx`). The flag gates TWO things: (1) the raster DoF pass in `EffectsImpl` (only on High/Maximum tiers, so a live-scene pixel diff would need a real-GPU High-tier session and isn't a clean 'simple' rung); (2) the HQ Render modal's lens controls — with the flag OFF it shows one f-stop fallback dropdown ('Depth of field'), with it ON it shows the FULL lens control set (focal length + aperture selects, auto-focus checkbox, focus-distance input). This rung exercises (2) — a real DOM-level Simple/Pro-ish gate proof plus a real interaction (changing the aperture actually commits to the store) — since it needs no GPU tier switch and no path-tracer session. Opens the modal via `setHqRenderOpen(true)` directly (no need to actually start a render).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: assert-fallback-only
steps.eval: (() => { if (document.querySelector('[aria-label="Lens focal length"]')) throw new Error('cameraDof=false should hide the full lens controls'); if (!document.querySelector('[aria-label="Depth of field"]')) throw new Error('cameraDof=false should still show the simple DoF-stop fallback select'); })()

steps.name: wait-lens-controls
steps.failMessage: cameraDof=true should reveal the full lens control set (focal length select)

steps.name: assert-full-controls
steps.eval: (() => { if (document.querySelector('[aria-label="Depth of field"]')) throw new Error('cameraDof=true should hide the simple fallback select'); if (!document.querySelector('[aria-label="Aperture (f-stop)"]')) throw new Error('aperture select missing'); })()

steps.name: open-aperture-select
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Aperture (f-stop)"]'); if (!b) throw new Error('aperture trigger not found'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: pick-f2.8
steps.eval: (() => { const opt = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]')].find(o => o.textContent.includes('2.8')); if (!opt) throw new Error('f/2.8 option not found'); opt.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-fstop-committed
steps.failMessage: picking f/2.8 in the Pro lens controls should commit state.dofFStop = 2.8

steps.name: assert-auto-focus-checkbox-present
steps.eval: (() => { if (!document.querySelector('[aria-label="Auto-focus on the centre of the view"]')) throw new Error('auto-focus checkbox should be visible once DoF is on') })()

steps.name: assert-focus-distance-field-visible
steps.failMessage: focus distance field should show once DoF is on and auto-focus is turned off
